narrative.northStar: A precise ledger inside the writing workspace
narrative.overview: User-requested Focus Flow UX clone: quiet tabs, ellipsis menus, searchable currency and account dialogs, six-row category pagination and contrast-adapted accent swatches.

rules.name: Native amounts remain visible
rules.body: A converted valuation always retains its native summaries and current-rate label.

dos: Expose incomplete data and exact partial-save outcomes.
donts: Do not rely on color alone or imply bank connectivity.
